## Definition of Done

See [BEU-ICT/certificate-manager#23](https://github.com/BEU-ICT/certificate-manager/issues/23), section 9.

- [ ] All acceptance criteria of the task are ticked and demonstrable
- [ ] CI is green (lint, typecheck, dependency-cruiser, tests, build)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; no skipped tests
- [ ] Public interfaces documented (OpenAPI, module README, `infra/README.md`/runbook)
- [ ] No new lint warnings, no unjustified `any`, no TODO without an issue link
- [ ] Security: inputs validated, authorization enforced, no secrets/PII logged
- [ ] i18n: no hard-coded user-visible strings; both `az` and `en` provided
- [ ] Issue description updated if scope changed
